beat_summaries.narrative_intent: Viewer understands that the same market has a public entrance and a deeper professional database, so visible information is structurally limited.
beat_summaries.visual_composition: A large dark broker database slides into dominance behind a smaller public portal; a lock threshold appears between them and only a thin output card escapes.
beat_summaries.why_avoids_slideshow_whiteboard_effect: The beat is staged as a door/threshold event with one focal split-screen system, not as separate note cards explaining the concept.

beat_summaries.narrative_intent: Viewer understands that the service narrows many options into one recommended property while keeping the drawback visible.
beat_summaries.visual_composition: Rejected cards slide to the edges, one property sheet remains center stage, and a warning callout attaches to the selected sheet.
beat_summaries.why_avoids_slideshow_whiteboard_effect: The screen is a selection event: cards are spatially rejected, one sheet is framed, and the drawback is attached to the chosen object.

beat_summaries.narrative_intent: Viewer understands that an AI-like system can confidently highlight one property as the best match.
beat_summaries.visual_composition: A dark AI system panel scans, a match arrow fires, and a single property card becomes the focal target with a confidence badge.
beat_summaries.why_avoids_slideshow_whiteboard_effect: The beat is a scanning and targeting event with one highlighted card, not a board of explanatory labels.

beat_summaries.narrative_intent: Viewer understands that the AI recommendation is not final because hidden real-estate risks interrupt it and make the choice conditional.
beat_summaries.visual_composition: The matched property remains in the center, then red/yellow risk zones cover it and a dark conditional strip overrides the previous recommendation.
beat_summaries.why_avoids_slideshow_whiteboard_effect: The beat uses interruption and occlusion: risk zones physically cover the recommendation instead of listing risk notes beside it.
